scenarios.title: Bias in Resume Screening
scenarios.prompt_text: Your AI resume screening tool consistently ranks candidates from certain universities higher. An equally qualified candidate from a lesser-known school is ranked lower. How should you evaluate the tool's recommendation?
scenarios.what_it_tests: Tests CO-2/CO-3 balance — abstract credential signals vs. concrete qualification evidence.
scenarios.success_indicator: Applies fair, principled reasoning while addressing operational realities.
scenarios.failure_indicator: Defaults to expedient choice without ethical consideration.

scenarios.title: Internal vs External Candidate
scenarios.prompt_text: An internal candidate expects the promotion but an external candidate is objectively more qualified. The internal candidate has been loyal for 10 years. How do you make the decision?
scenarios.what_it_tests: Tests F4 (Connection) vs F5 (Agency) — loyalty vs. merit.
scenarios.success_indicator: Applies fair, principled reasoning while addressing operational realities.
scenarios.failure_indicator: Defaults to expedient choice without ethical consideration.
